title: I Think Faster Than Light Travel is Possible. Here's Why.
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder explains why she thinks faster-than-light travel may not be ruled out. She argues that the standard objections from special relativity are inconclusive.
why: Commenters recommend it for a compelling, accessible case against treating the speed of light as a hard limit.

quote.text: She does seem to have a pretty compelling argument that the speed of light may not be the maximum speed.
